description: Asks how Database.Execute (dbFailOnError) answers statements from other dialects and engines, on a writable copy, each followed by DBEngine.Errors: TRUNCATE, MERGE, REPLACE INTO, ON DUPLICATE KEY and INSERT OR REPLACE, RETURNING, RENAME in both forms, IF [NOT] EXISTS, CREATE TABLE ... AS SELECT and ... LIKE and ... ENGINE, CREATE DATABASE, USE, SET, transaction keywords, EXPLAIN, SHOW, DESCRIBE, PRAGMA, EXEC and CALL, SELECT INTO a # name and an existing table, ANALYZE, VACUUM, LOCK TABLE, DECLARE, PRINT, CREATE SEQUENCE, TRIGGER, FUNCTION and SCHEMA, and COMMENT ON. The TableDefs names are listed at the end. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.

args.text: MERGE INTO U USING Dm ON U.ID = Dm.ID WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE

INSERT OR REPLACE INTO U (ID, K) VALUES (1, 'a')
INSERT INTO U (ID, K) VALUES (1, 'a') RETURNING ID
UPDATE U SET K = 'x' RETURNING K
ALTER TABLE U RENAME TO U9
ALTER TABLE U RENAME COLUMN K TO K9
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Q1 (A LONG)
CREATE TABLE Q2 AS SELECT * FROM One
CREATE TABLE Q4 (A LONG) ENGINE = X
